title: Trends and Predictions for the Sydney Property Market in 2025
paragraphs: At CM Lawyers, we have experts specialising in property law and conveyancing, and they can guide you in every step of homebuying, starting from finding the best property for your needs. To help you with your initial search, we have compiled some trends and predictions for the Sydney property market in 2025.

The housing market has seen a substantial increase in 2024, with house values in Sydney rising by 4.5%. According to ANZ’s bank forecast, there’s a potential 5% increase in Sydney house prices by 2025. Buyers can expect a consistent rise in house price in Australia Sydney, driven by increased buyer demand and supply shortages.
